title: Photoacoustic pulse from Beer-Lambert absorption (analytic)
description:
A 1.55 um plane wave (em_fdfd_ez line source, y-periodic strip) enters an absorbing fluid at x0 = 6 um (sigma_e = 4e3 S/m: power decay mu ~ 1e6 /m) and decays as exp(-mu (x - x0)); em_acoustics_photoacoustic hands the absorbed power q(x) to elastic_waves, which multiplies it by a gaussian heating envelope (width w = 0.1 ns, centre t_h = 0.4 ns). Both physics share one fluid acoustically (rho 1000, c 1500, Grueneisen 0.11), so sound crosses x0 without reflection; the acoustic absorbing layers lie in the EM CPML padding (40 cells).
Analytic: q0 = sigma |t|^2 A^2 / 2 (|t|^2 = 4 n1^2 / ((n1 + n')^2 + kappa^2)), mu = 2 k0 kappa (with the discrete-grid factor 1/sqrt(1 - (n1 k0 dx/2)^2)); 1D wave equation with source G dq/dt: before the absorber p(x, t) = (G q0 sqrt(pi) w / 4) exp(b^2 - mu c T) erfc(b - T / w), b = mu c w / 2, T = t - t_h - (x0 - x) / c; inside it the left- and right-going parts add (see pressure_profile).
Probes tab: acoustics.probe (0.49 um before x0) against the dashed curve: a rise over ~w, then the exp(-mu c T) tail of the light profile.
Line profile tab (final state, t_end = 3.8 ns): absorbed_profile on em.absorbed_power and pressure_profile on acoustics.pressure (left-going exponential near x = 1 um, right-going front near x = 11 um).
Derived values tab: q_front (first absorber cell, q0 exp(-mu dx/2)), P_abs_total (q0 Ly / mu), p_at_arrival (T = 0) and p_one_decay (T = 1 / (mu c)); expected ~0.5-2 % (grid dispersion of mu, front-face reflection, ~7.5-cell pulse rise).

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the FDFD solve

parameters.name: sigma_abs
parameters.description: optical conductivity of the absorbing part in S/m

parameters.name: eps_im
parameters.description: -Im eps = sigma / (omega eps0) of the absorber (0.372)

parameters.name: ksi_grid
parameters.description: half-cell optical phase (grid dispersion factor of mu)

parameters.name: mu_abs
parameters.description: power attenuation of the discrete wave in 1/m (~1.0e6)

parameters.name: A_src
parameters.description: E_z amplitude the line source radiates to each side in V/m

parameters.name: q0
parameters.description: absorbed power density just inside x0 in W/m^3

parameters.name: w_heat
parameters.description: 1/e half-width of the gaussian heating envelope in s (c w = 7.5 cells)

parameters.name: t_heat
parameters.description: centre time of the heating envelope

parameters.name: a_dec
parameters.description: decay rate mu c of the pressure tail in 1/s

parameters.name: p_scale
parameters.description: pressure scale G q0 sqrt(pi) w / 4 in Pa (half the initial pressure G H at x0 is 2 p_scale)

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: window length (mu (Lx - x0) = 10: the light is gone at the far edge)

parameters.name: y_mid
parameters.description: y of the probe and the profile lines (a cell centre)

parameters.name: x_p
parameters.description: pressure probe (cell centre, 0.49 um before x0)

parameters.name: x0_abs
parameters.description: absorber front face x0 (a cell face, 6 um)

parameters.name: Tr_end
parameters.description: time since the heating centre at t_end

analytic_curves.name: pressure_profile
analytic_curves.expression: p_scale*where(x < x0_abs, exp(b_par**2 - a_dec*(Tr_end - (x0_abs - x)/c_fl))*erfc(b_par - (Tr_end - (x0_abs - x)/c_fl)/w_heat), exp(-mu_abs*(x - x0_abs))*(exp(b_par**2 - a_dec*Tr_end)*erfc(b_par - Tr_end/w_heat) + exp(b_par**2 + a_dec*Tr_end)*(erf(Tr_end/w_heat + b_par) + erf((x - x0_abs)/(c_fl*w_heat) - Tr_end/w_heat - b_par))))
